name: Ironband's Compound
summary: At Ironband's Compound, Tormus Deepforge seeks vengeance for his slain mentor. Sturgy Ironband's teaching outpost in eastern Dun Morogh fell after a shipment of rare umbral ore drew the Dark Iron dwarves.

sections.title: A Master's Fall
sections.body: Sturgy Ironband taught smithing at a secluded compound south of Helm's Bed Lake. Across Ironforge, he was revered as an unmatched instructor. He trained promising pupils far from the crowded anvils of the Great Forge. That peaceful work ended when one student acquired an unfamiliar mineral called umbral ore. Intrigued by its properties, Ironband chose to experiment with the sample. He did not know that possessing the ore had marked his school for ruin.

sections.title: The Dark Iron Raid
sections.body: Dark Iron dwarves attacked the compound soon after the umbral ore arrived. The assault was sudden and ruthless. They killed Sturgy Ironband and every apprentice in his care, then took over the grounds. Tormus Deepforge, one of Ironband's surviving protégés in the capital, refuses to let the massacre go unanswered. He sends Alliance travelers to avenge his teacher and recover the ore that brought destruction to the outpost.

faq.answer: Ironband's Compound lies in eastern Dun Morogh, south of Helm's Bed Lake.
Sturgy Ironband was a renowned dwarven master blacksmith who trained students in advanced metalworking at a compound outside Ironforge. Dark Iron dwarves killed him in a raid.

faq.q: Why did the Dark Iron dwarves attack the compound?
faq.answer: A shipment of umbral ore brought by one of Ironband's students drew the Dark Iron dwarves to the compound. They attacked soon after it arrived, killed everyone present, and took control of the site.
Umbral ore is an uncommon, mysterious mineral that caught Master Ironband's interest. Its arrival drew the lethal attention of the Dark Iron clan.
Tormus Deepforge is an Ironforge blacksmith and former apprentice of Sturgy Ironband. Grieving his teacher's death, he sends travelers to punish the Dark Iron intruders and retrieve the ore.

faq.q: What does Tormus want recovered from the compound?
faq.answer: Tormus wants travelers to avenge Ironband by driving out the Dark Iron raiders and recover the shipment of umbral ore that brought the disaster.

angles.text: Sturgy Ironband's fate shows the danger that untested ores can bring to a forge.
The attack on Ironband's outpost reflects the bitter hatred between Ironforge's Bronzebeard dwarves and their Dark Iron kin.
